en-US.description: Ask Audio Nudge a question and hear the top result from Google Programmable Search. Continue asking questions until you say end question session.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask audio nudge what causes rain
Alexa, tell audio nudge end question session
en-US.name: Audio Nudge
en-US.summary: Ask questions and hear concise Google search results.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open Audio Nudge and ask a question. After the answer and nudge message, ask another question. Say 'end question session' to exit.
